Context: 4. Deputation (Duty) Allowance

6. On appointment from one ex cadre post to another ex cadre post where the employee opts to draw pay in the Level (in Pay Matrix)-/ Pay Scale of the ex cadre post, the pay in the second or subsequent ex cadre post should be fixed under the normal rules with reference to the pay in the cadre post only.
